description: This is a test file for tenantClient utility functions, testing functions such as normalizeTenantId, fetchSessionTenants, selectTenant, and setActiveTenant.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes various shapes of tenant identifiers into a string or null.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches and returns an array of session tenants from the server.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Selects a tenant, updates local storage, and makes a POST request.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Writes the active tenant ID to local storage and removes legacy keys.
